name: riemannHypothesis
label: The Riemann hypothesis
statement: Every nontrivial zero of the Riemann zeta function has real part 1/2, as stated in Mathlib.

name: riemannZeta_eq_zero_re
label: Zeta zeros on the critical line
statement: Every zero of the Riemann zeta function away from the negative even integers and the point 1 has real part 1/2.

name: LFunction_ne_zero_of_half_lt_re
label: Dirichlet L-functions are zero-free to the right of the critical line
statement: For every Dirichlet character of positive modulus, its L-function is nonzero when the real part of the argument exceeds 1/2. The point 1 is excepted for the principal character.

name: LFunction_eq_zero_re
label: Dirichlet zeros in the critical strip
statement: For every Dirichlet character of positive modulus, zeros of its L-function with real part strictly between 0 and 1 have real part 1/2.

name: LFunction_eq_zero_re_of_isPrimitive
label: Critical-strip zeros for primitive Dirichlet characters
statement: For every primitive Dirichlet character of positive modulus, zeros of its L-function with real part strictly between 0 and 1 have real part 1/2.
